name: Angmar
source: Angmar is a hunter who wants to become a propper archer. She wants to show that she's more than just a pretty body and face and wants to make the difference. She'll mostly be patroling the perimeters in the morning and you can visit the tavern together with her and can pursue romantic interest with her.
